pure-announcement.rationale: It documents a working methodology and skills library rather than announcing a launch or release; the linked release announcement is peripheral.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concept, Agent Skills format, covers the SKILL.md packaging and progressive-disclosure standard — not this opinionated development methodology built on top of skills.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are checkable against the open-source repo, and skill behaviour is itself tested with a documented eval harness.

durability.rationale: The workflow core — tease out a spec before any code, write plans an unskilled junior could follow, dispatch a fresh subagent per task with two-stage review, and enforce red/green TDD to the point of deleting code written before tests — is a harness-agnostic process pattern; only the fourteen install sections are ephemeral.

actionability.rationale: A reader can either install it in one command on their harness or lift the process itself — mandatory skill checks before tasks, subagent-driven development with spec-compliance then code-quality review — into their own agent setup.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — composable skills that enforce a spec-first, TDD, subagent-driven development methodology — states in a paragraph; the per-harness install guides and skill catalogue are packaging around it.
